'''Ord Zynthar'''<ref name="EGTW" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Ord Zynthar system/Legends|Ord Zynthar system]]. It was situated in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

Ord Zynthar served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], despite it being located outside the borders of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. When the Republic launched the [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the [[Teirasan]] and [[Zarracine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[11,660 BBY]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] moved from the [[Mon Gazza system/Legends|Mon Gazza system]] in the Republic's territory to the [[Teirasa system/Legends|Teirasa system]] via Ord Zynthar.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Zynthar was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ord Zynthar [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world itself, in grid square P-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
